title: Fix missing default item journal batch in Contoso Inventory setup
summary: Inventory's default item journal batch is now created with its template during Contoso setup, removing the dependency on Manufacturing, Service, or Jobs modules for this creation.
key_points: Item journal batch is generated alongside its template in the item journal template creation helper
Common and Warehouse module generation no longer requires Manufacturing, Service, or Jobs to create the default batch
Batch settings are preserved using existing helper functionality
Three regression tests validate batch creation, template handling, and settings preservation
No breaking changes to numbering or dependencies
